text_block_list.text:
New members were steadily joining the 
team. Then, one day—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy, Trainer-san! Listen to this and 
prepare to be surprised!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I just thought of a way to power up our 
team even more!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, we must decide on a team 
name, yes! We shall give it a happy name 
that everyone will love, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I can't think of anything right NOW, 
but... as soon as something comes to mind, 
I'll tell you♪

With those parting words, Taiki Shuttle 
blew past and departed like a whirlwind.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I thought of a team name! The theme is 
everyone having fun and cheering together 
in harmony!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's <HOP CHEERS>! Fufu, what do you 
think?

Maybe we should consider the team name 
they suggested!
